test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The country's infrastructure vision for FY-2025 and the first exercise to be conducted in India is named as ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Infrastructure Pipeline.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Infrastructures Pipeline covers over 6,000 projects across various sectors.
 
• It includes:
 
 
• Energy: Includes power, renewable energy, and oil & gas.
 
• Roads: National and state highways, rural roads.
 
• Urban Infrastructure: Urban transport, water supply
